Name: (CP) T's Terrain Flooring
Author: tikamin557
Description:
[center][color=#ffff00][size=6][b]T's Terrain Flooring[/b][/size][/color]
Decorate your farm with customizable dirt, grass, and decorative flooring using T's Core![/center]
[line]
[color=#00ffff][size=5][b]About[/b][/size][/color]
T's Terrain Flooring adds a collection of customizable flooring items designed to change the appearance of the ground.
Each flooring item includes multiple texture variations, allowing you to create paths, grassy areas, natural-looking terrain, and decorative details without needing a separate item for every design.
This mod uses the Custom Flooring system introduced in [size=4][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/50043]T's Core[/url] v1.9.9[/size].

[size=4][b][color=#00ff00]Compatible with recolor mods![/color][/b] [/size]
Flooring textures reflect recolor changes applied by compatible recolor mods, helping them blend naturally with your game's appearance.

[color=#ffff00][size=4][b]Included Flooring[/b][/size][/color]
[list]
[*][i]Dirt Flooring (Light)[/i][/*]
[*]Dirt Flooring (Dark)[/*]
[*][i]Grass Flooring (Light Dirt)[/i][/*]
[*]Grass Flooring (Dark Dirt)[/*]
[*][i]Grass Flooring (Rich Green)[/i][/*]
[*]Grass Flooring (Deep Green)[/*]
[*]Bonus Flooring[/*]
[/list]The Bonus Flooring collection includes pebbles, flowers, fallen leaves, decorative objects, and random texture variations.
Some textures also include animation.
[line]
[color=#00ffff][size=5][b]How to Use[/b][/size][/color]
[b][color=#ffff00]Example: Blending Modified Terrain[/color][/b]
If another mod changes the terrain and leaves some areas looking unnatural, you can use T's Terrain Flooring to help those spots blend in with their surroundings. (See images for examples.)
You can also press F8 (configurable in T's Core's GMCM settings) to identify placed flooring tiles. (See images.)
All flooring items can be crafted without ingredients.
[b][color=#ffff00]Basic Controls[/color][/b]
[list]
[*][i][b]Right-click:[/b] Place the selected flooring.[/i][/*]
[*][b]Left-click:[/b] Switch to the next texture before placing.[/*]
[*][b]Shift + Left-click:[/b] Pick up placed custom flooring.[/*]
[/list]You can also use the texture selection UI to choose a texture directly.
T's Core provides additional keybinds, including Previous Texture and Identify Placed Flooring. These can be configured through T's Core's GMCM settings.
[b][color=#ffff00]Random Textures[/color][/b]
Some Bonus Flooring variations use random textures.
Their appearance is randomly selected when placed and rerolled each in-game day, making it easy to create naturally varied ground decorations.
[line]
[color=#00ffff][size=5][b]Texture Selection UI[/b][/size][/color]
When holding custom flooring, a texture selection UI can appear on the screen.
Two display modes are available:
[list]
[*][i][b]Builder:[/b] Displays all available textures in a grid.[/i][/*]
[*][b]Carousel:[/b] Displays textures horizontally, with the selected texture and nearby options.[/*]
[/list]You can click a texture in either mode to select it directly.
The following options can be configured through GMCM:
[list]
[*][i]Enable or disable the texture selection UI.[/i][/*]
[*]Choose Builder or Carousel mode.[/*]
[*][i]Choose how many textures appear in Carousel mode (3, 5, 7, or 9).[/i][/*]
[*]Show or hide the selected texture's name.[/*]
[*]Adjust the UI size and position.[/*]
[/list][line]
[color=#00ffff][size=5][b]Additional Settings[/b][/size][/color]
[b][color=#ffff00]Allow Flooring Replacement[/color][/b]
Allows you to place another flooring over existing custom flooring.
When replacement succeeds, the original flooring is returned to you as an item.
[b][color=#ffff00]Recipe Display Page[/color][/b]
Choose where the flooring crafting recipes appear:
[list]
[*][i][b]Custom (T's Core):[/b] Displays the recipes on T's Core's custom recipe page.[/i][/*]
[*][b]Vanilla:[/b] Displays the recipes on the normal crafting page.[/*]
[/list]The recipes appear only on the selected page.
[line]
[color=#00ffff][size=5][b]Requirements & Installation[/b][/size][/color]
[b]Required Mods:[/b]
[list]
[*][i]SMAPI[/i][/*]
[*]Content Patcher[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/50043]T's Core[/url] v1.9.9 or later[/*]
[/list][line]
